title: Two Different Nations‼️ #jacobvsEsau #iuic #history #godspeople #nation
segments: And the Lord said unto her, "Two nations
are in thy womb." He said, "Rebecca, I
got news for you, sis. Two nations, two
nationalities, two races, it's the same
thing, are in your womb." Now, we all
know that when a man and a woman come
together and they bring forth a child
and that child come from that man,
they're the same race. God says, "No,
no, no, no,
no. This is different. I put two
different races in Isaac to put inside
of you. They're not the same. They're
completely different nations. One is of
Yah, the other is the devil. That's what
he's saying basically. Go ahead.
Two nations are in thy womb. And two
manner of people shall be separated from
thy bow. And two manner of people, two
manner, you're going to look different,
act different, think different, look
different. Speak different, live
different, think different.
